bio: This family-run restaurant is now in its third generation. Whether you sit in the rustic-style dining area with its regulars' table or in the pleasant conservatory, you are assured of friendly service. The menu features home-style, regional and more sophisticated dishes. Order à la carte or opt for one of the daily specials on the blackboard. In summer, make a beeline for the outdoor seating area, which is shaded by old trees....
